gaps.lead: 'I broke the window,' said the boy.
gaps.explanation: admit + -ing (optionally 'to'): admitted breaking / admitted to breaking.
suggest + -ing (or suggest that + clause): suggested having.

gaps.lead: He is so impatient that he never reads instructions.
gaps.explanation: so impatient that he never reads = too impatient to read.

gaps.lead: I'm sure the tickets are expensive this year.
gaps.explanation: must be = I'm sure it is (deduction).

gaps.lead: We took a spare tyre in case the journey went wrong.
gaps.sentence: We took a spare tyre ___ went wrong.
gaps.explanation: in case + clause = as a precaution because something might happen.

gaps.lead: She moved to Paris and now finds the pace normal.
gaps.sentence: She ___ the pace of life in Paris.
gaps.explanation: get used to / be used to + -ing or noun: is now used to. 'got used to' also fits if the process is complete.
